definitions.gloss: sekiwake; the third-highest rank in sumo
definitions.explanation: The rank below ōzeki and above komusubi. With ōzeki and komusubi it is one of the san'yaku, the titled ranks below yokozuna.

examples.japanese: {関脇|せきわけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{今場所|こんばしょ}→今場所：33059_konbasho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{関脇|せきわけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}した→優勝する：25496_yuushousuru⟧。
{関脇|せきわけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{三場所|さんばしょ}⟦{勝|か}ち→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧{続|つづ}ければ、⟦{大関|おおぜき}→大関：12662_oozeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧なれる⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If he keeps winning for three tournaments as sekiwake, he may be promoted to ōzeki.

notes:
The sumo ranks from the top: ⟦{横綱|よこづな}→横綱：14957_yokozuna⟧, ⟦{大関|おおぜき}→大関：12662_oozeki⟧, {関脇|せきわけ}, {小結|こむすび}, then {前頭|まえがしら}. A sekiwake who wins about 33 bouts over three straight tournaments is usually promoted to ōzeki.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {関脇|せきわけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted to sekiwake
- {新関脇|しんせきわけ}: a wrestler in his first tournament as sekiwake
- {関脇|せきわけ}⟦{陥落|かんらく}→陥落：14594_kanraku⟧: dropping down from sekiwake
